exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, Alternative C - Questionnaire review
note: Records the AI configuration actually used for this exercise. No credentials are stored here. Categories that were not used are marked not-used rather than filled with invented components.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude on the web (claude.ai) with Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 chosen per task, and Claude Code (VS Code extension 2.1.294) with Claude Opus 5.5. The brief permits generating the whole solution; what was generated and what the candidate did is recorded in notes/llm-usage.md.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: Claude Code VS Code extension 2.1.294, default configuration. No other editor plugins or browser extensions affected this exercise.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Anthropic Messages API, claude-sonnet-4-5 (end-of-life 2026-11-30; replay unaffected). temperature 0 (sent with extra_body because anthropic 1.x removed it from the create() signature), max_tokens 1024. Mode switch live/replay/stub in app/config.py, overridable by environment variable.

skills.notes: Claude Code's bundled claude-api skill was loaded once, unmodified, to confirm the anthropic 1.x SDK change before fixing app/model_client.py. It ships with the extension and is not a repository file. The starter pack's generate-assignment-data skill was read but not installed or run. No custom skill was created.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: No CLAUDE.md, project agent instructions or subagent definitions.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No hooks were configured. A reviewer therefore has no hook command to read before running anything in this repository.

prompts_and_rules.notes: The application's system prompt and user-prompt builder live in app/drafting.py as module constants, in version control. Instructions sit in the system prompt; document text is passed in the user message inside <passage> tags, so document content is data rather than instruction.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: No MCP servers or tool integrations were used for this exercise. The application makes a single plain Messages API call per question and uses no tool calling.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: MODEL_API_KEY is the only secret. It is read from the environment, never written to disk, and never logged; cache/ and checks/ were searched for the key prefix before committing. Claude Code permissions were left at the extension defaults (each command approved when prompted). .gitignore excludes .env and the SQLite database.
